name: 22-inch Pythons
Text: When your opponent's card is unsuccessful, you may overturn 2 and Bury 2- Ringside cards. When your first card each turn is unsuccessful, they RFG 2 Ringside cards (when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you choose the cards instead). When your 'Classic' maneuver is successful, you may hide this card and your maneuver is +10D.

name: Ah-SHOOOOSH!
Text: As an action, Recover this card. When successful, you may put SHOOOOOOOOOOOSH Please! from your Ringside into your Ring, and your opponent may discard 1 action; if they do not, Bury 1- Ringside card, Draw 1-, and Stack 1- RFG card.

name: Alpha Academy
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. Your 'Suplex', 'Splash', and 'Lock' maneuvers are Chain when you have no Ring card with that card's title. When you are Otis, your non-Unique 'Splash' and 'Block' maneuvers are Multi Strikes instead, and ignore 'Can only be played...'.

name: Alpha Olympics
Text: * Can only be revealed when you play Alpha Academy. Packed: you can pack 3- Greco-Roman Holiday! in your Backstage, they count as Superstar-specific for other card effects; at the end of the Pre-match phase, put them in your Backlash. They do not take up Ring slots, replace 'Cannot' with 'Can only', and when they are successful, end the turn. During your turn you may discard 1 maneuver, and your next Superstar-specific maneuver played this turn is a TMF instead.

name: Arm Wrestling Champion of the World
Text: Cannot be blanked. At the end of the Pre-match phase, overturn 10- and your opponent overturns that many; If this effect is reversed, Recover your Ringside. When their turn ends and they did not play a maneuver, look at their hand, choose 1-, and they Bury it. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your 'Classic' maneuvers played are TMF instead.

name: Atlantic City Avalanche
Text: When played after Throw into the Corner Turnbuckle, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. When damage is resolved and this card applied 15D+, RFG your opponent's Ringside.

name: Backlund's Textbook Atomic Drop
Text: When you have F: 25+, +10D and a TMF instead. When this card is Multi, ignore 'completely' on reversals to it. When Mister Backlund is revealed, Bury 6- Ringside cards.

name: Billy Graham
Text: During your turn you can discard 2, and your opponent chooses one: discard 2 or their Superstar Ability is blank until the start of your next turn. When they draw for Stun, you may reveal a hidden Backstage Card. You can pack Texas Bullrope Match, Feathered Boa and Glorious Moustache.

name: Bob Backlund
Text: Superstar Ability: When your 'Textbook' maneuver is successful, Arsenal Search 1 'Textbook' maneuver; when it is unsuccessful, Ringside Search 1- 'Textbook' maneuver. You can pack Collegiate Champions, Make Darren Young Great Again (you count as Darren Young for it), and 3- Textbook Chicken Wing.

name: Built Like Heavy Machinery
Text: Put Sustained Damage from your Backlash into your Ring; it is Permanent, and replace '2' with '3' in the text. Your Head Butt Drop is Multi, and when played as a Counter, ignore 'Can only be played...'.

name: Chad Gable
Text: When your opponent discards or overturns for the Chain trait, you may RFG 1- of those cards. When their effect would move a maneuver from your Ring, you may reveal 1 Hand maneuver and draw 1 instead. You can pack Ready..., ...Willing..., ...and Gable, Alpha Ankle Lock, Gable's Roll-Through Suplex, and Greco-Roman Specialists.

name: Gable-sault
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successful maneuver; Recover 5- Ringside cards. As a reversal, -15F; when overturned reverse any non-unique maneuver, and put this card into your hand.

name: I Demand a Five Count!
Text: When played after a successful 5D+ maneuver, can only be reversed from Ring. Your opponent overturns until they overturn 5 reversals. When successful, this card counts as a maneuver for your effects.

name: King Kong Bundy
Text: When your 5D+ maneuver is successful and damage is applied, RFG 2-  Opponent's Ringside cards (when 5D+ was applied, 3- instead). You can pack BASH cards as if they are not BASH, Managers as if you are a Legend, 10 additional Arsenal cards, As Big and Tough as Any Two Men, and No Sell Maneuver.

name: Mammoth Elbow Smash
Text: As a maneuver, -5F; can only be reversed by D: 0 reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any maneuver played as a Counter.

name: Mister Backlund
Text: When The All-American Boy is revealed, hide this card. Your opponent's Superstar Value is -2. The damage of your 'Textbook' maneuvers cannot be reduced. Replace '3-' with '6-' in the text of your Textbook Chicken Wing. Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 5- and your next maneuver this turn is +#D and -#F (# = cards overturned).

name: Otis
Text: All players' maneuvers are +1 Stun. When your opponent's maneuver with Stun is unsuccessful, they overturn equal to the maneuver's Stun. You can pack No Sell Maneuver and OOOOH YEAH! (ignore 'Blindside'). You cannot pack There is No Escape or Stun the Crowd.

name: Sensational Championship Savvy
Text: Put 1- Title Belt and any 'Sherri' cards from your Backlash into your Ring.  Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Hand card or 1 Ring non-Active Run-in, and play a Strike or High Risk from Ringside that is 'Blindside', 'Classic', or 'Textbook' as if from Hand; it counts as a Run-in for your effects.

name: Sensational Sherri
Text: Cannot be blanked. In Ring: Your opponent cannot block your Run-ins or increase their Fortitude. When your Run-in is successful, they may overturn 2; if they do not, Bury 3- Ringside cards. In Ring: Your Splash and Classic Splash are TMF for reversals, and when played as a Counter, ignore 'Can only be played...'.

name: Sensational Sleeper
Text: When your opponent is a Female superstar, can be played from Ringside. When they are a Male superstar, this card is a Run-in. In Ring: replace 'successful' with 'played' on your Sensational Sherri.

name: Sets and Reps
Text: Your opponent discards 1 and overturns 3; this effect cannot be reversed. They discard 1 and overturn 3; reversals to this effect are +10F. They discard 1 and overturn 3; when this effect is not reversed, they randomly Recover 2- Ringside cards. In Ring: your maneuvers with 4+ Stun are Multi.

name: Sherri Martel
Text: Reveal 1 Enforcer card and choose 1 Enforcer. Your 'Manager' cards are Run-ins. You can pack Managed by Sherri Martel, Manager Distracts, and 1 Sherri Martel-specific Enforcer; you can pack 'Manage' and 'Interfere' cards as if they are not Heel or Raw.

name: SHOOOOOOOOOOOSH Please!
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. No player may play 'Guest Ringside Announcer' or 'Talk' cards. ACE: Any player may overturn 3 and allow their opponent to Stack 1- Ringside card and then reverse a non-Superstar-specific action.

name: Steaks and Weights
Text: Reverse any action, or any non-Superstar-specific maneuver with printed Stun. Draw #- (# = the reversed card's Stun).

name: Textbook Bridging Pin
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver with a reversal restriction (when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, after any maneuver). End the turn. In Ring: when you have 10+ Ring 'Textbook' maneuvers, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Textbook Crossface Chickenwing
Text: As a maneuver, -20F; when your next card played this turn is Maintain Hold, ignore 'Can only be played...'. As a reversal, reverse any Submission or Superstar-specific maneuver.

name: The All-American Boy
Text: Your Superstar Value is +2. Once during each of your turns, you may discard 1 Backlash card, and your next 'Textbook' maneuver played this turn is -5F (when you have lower Fortitude, it is Multi). Your Collegiate Champions is Permanent, and when you have lower Fortitude, its ACE cannot be reversed.

name: The Caterpillar
Text: Multi: 3 Can only be played after a successful maneuver, or as a Counter (5D+ maneuver). Your opponent discards # (# = your total Ring Stun).

name: The Macho King or The Heart Break Kid?
Text: Revealed: your From the Top Rope cannot be reversed, and your cards played as a Counter (with a Run-in) are Run-ins. ≥ Hand Size: +8 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +Your 'Elbow' cards are +4D. Your 'Elbow' and 'Blindside' maneuvers count as 'Classic' for your effects. Your The King Interferes! is -7F. ≥ Hand Size: +5 Superstar Value: +2 Superstar Ability: +Before your Draw Segment, reveal your bottom Arsenal card. When it is a High Risk, you may put it in your hand; if it is not, shuffle and draw 1-.

name: The Man of the Hour
Text: As an action, when played after a successful maneuver, your opponent cannot respond to this card. When successful, Bury 4- Ringside cards and Arsenal/Ringside Search 2- Superstar-specific cards.

name: The Man With the Power
Text: As an action, when The Man of the Hour is in your Ring, cannot be reversed by non-Superstar-specific cards. Recover 5- Ringside cards and draw 1-, your opponent overturns 5. In Ring: your maneuvers are +2D and when successful, they overturn 1.

name: The Number 1 Guy!
Text: Draw 1- and your opponent RFG 1 Hand card. When you would discard exactly 1 for their card effects, you may instead overturn 1.

name: The Sensational Queen
Text: When you have Allegiance: WWF, can be played from Ringside. Bury 5- Hand cards, Bury up to that many Ringside cards, and Bury up to that many RFG cards. When Living the Good Life is in your Ringside, you may put it into your Backlash.

name: The Walking Condominium
Text: When Handicap Match is in your opponent's Ring, this card gains its text. You can play a 'Jimmy' or 'Legendary' Manager during any Pre-match Phase. Your 'Power', 'Splash', 'Drop', and BASH maneuvers are +5D.

name: Too Sweet to be Sour
Text: As an action, when you have 3+ Ring Superstar-specifics, can only be reversed from Arsenal; Arsenal Search 2- non-Hybrid maneuvers that are non-Unique or 'Classic'. In Ring: your maneuvers are -5F, and your opponent cannot modify the Fortitude or Damage of your cards.

name: You've Not Been Beaten Until You've Been Beaten By Bundy
Text: Choose one: your Hand Size is +2, or your opponent's Hand Size is -2. When they are a Tag Team or Stable, choose both. ACE: During your turn you may Eliminate this card and then they overturn 5; when your next card played this turn is a maneuver, ignore the 'Can only be played after...'.
